intro: Bring warmth and character to your dining area with Lisa chairs. Their cushioned microfiber seat, tall squared back, and elegant mahogany finish keep you comfortable and your meals beautifully styled.

features.title: Comfort built into every seat
features.text: A cushioned microfiber seat keeps you comfortable through family dinners, long conversations, or working from the table.

features.title: Tall squared back with support
features.text: The high backrest gently curves to support your posture, so you enjoy meals without feeling strained or restless.

features.title: Eye-catching geometric design
features.text: A symmetrical grid back adds a crafted, contemporary touch, making your dining space feel more stylish and welcoming.

features.title: Solid wood durability
features.text: Crafted in sturdy rubberwood with a warm Indian mahogany finish, the frame adds both strength and elegance to your home.

features.title: Sleek lines, timeless look
features.text: Clean angles and minimal form ensure the chairs blend seamlessly into both modern and traditional dining setups.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
